findings.summary: push_scope in __attrs_post_init__ also runs for every child validator created by descend/evolve and is never popped, so a subschema's $id can alter how a sibling's relative $ref resolves and the scope stack grows (reviewer says plausible, not reproduced).
id_of(self.schema) is pushed without a None check; a custom id_of passed to create() may return None, in which case the push should be skipped.
Three blank lines follow the new test instead of two, which will fail the E303/E305 lint check.
